correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Alexander dual: triangles automatically faces, tetrahedra exactly induced connected 4-sets; a dual 5-face would require an induced K_2,3 in the square cylinder, prohibited by at-most-two common neighbors. Independently formed relative F2 incidence matrices for every m=2..6: column/rank (37,34),(69,66),(73,70),(73,70),(73,70). Connected 4-vertex sets in the added terminal layer fit within the last four layers, establishing locality for ALL m>4. Independently checked source three explicit integral cube signed vectors have 16-term supports, zero integer boundaries, and mod-2 rank three; their relative images are nonzero because there is no 3-cycle confined to one 4-vertex layer. Long exact sequence therefore increments H3 by three per layer over Q and F2; top integral H3 subgroup of free C3. Cut-complex statement follows combinatorial Alexander duality; m2 is the known Q3 base. Finite ranks are required local certificates, not extrapolated infinite experiments.
residual_risks: No complete torsion or other-degree homology results; rank over F2 requires exact relative matrix and lifting over F2, both checked.
